rules.reason: Shells out to a native binary or service (arbitrary command, gdalinfo, readpst, unrar, dwgread, strings, encode-ocr). A JS library does not ship or spawn these; Tesseract is the one opt-in exception (parser-media TesseractOcrParser, bounded and flagged unsafe). Formats with a JS route are covered by our own parsers (OutlookPSTParser, ArchiveMetadataParser for RAR, ScienceMetadataParser for DWG).
NLP/ML parsers (Lucene geo-gazetteer, GROBID journal extraction, named-entity models) need JVM-resident models or external services; not a parser concern in a JS runtime.

Vendor SDK and credential parsers. ripstream exposes VlmOcrProvider (core/vlm.ts) so a caller injects any provider; shipping per-vendor clients would put API keys and network egress in the default install.
JNI binding to Tesseract. The CLI route (TesseractOcrParser) covers OCR.
BPG is a dead format superseded by HEIF/AVIF; no maintained JS decoder, nothing to gain.
Siemens/Creo PRT is proprietary and Tika's parser only reads a header; low value, decline unless a user needs it.
ActiveMime is a macro-malware container; the useful output is the embedded VBA, which the OLE route already exposes.
application/x-tika-pst-mail-item is an internal type Tika's PSTParser feeds to itself; OutlookPSTParser emits the mail items directly.
Pack200 is a JVM-only JAR compression removed from the JDK in 14; no JS decoder.
Camera RAW variants (Adobe, Epson, Kodak, Leaf, Nikon, Olympus, Panasonic, Pentax, Samsung, Sony): low value, decline unless a user needs one. Detection still identifies them.

Macro-enabled, template, slide/slideshow, Visio and XPS types are subtypes of the three base OOXML types and Tika's CompositeParser reaches the same OOXMLParser through the MediaTypeRegistry supertype (tikajs-68os.3). Verified by a forced-type differential.
application/x-ibooks+zip is a subtype of application/epub+zip; same EpubParser through the supertype (tikajs-68os.3).
Subtype of application/vnd.ms-excel; Tika's OfficeParser reaches the Excel extractor the same way (tikajs-68os.3).
Subtype of video/mp4; same MP4Parser through the supertype (tikajs-68os.3).
Source files are plain text via the text/* registration; the oracle's text is identical except that SourceCodeParser prefixes the resource name (output-quality diff, tikajs-68os.10).
JPEG XL: the XMP packet scanner and extractor are not ported.
Detected, but no parser reads the Unix dump format.
GRIB1/2 reads through netcdf-java's model, which is not portable, and the GRIB2 type is undetectable in Tika too. Owner decision pending (tikajs-68os.66).
